answer: Burnable stake vouching resists sybils: every new agent needs distinct, staked peers to vouch for it, and a voucher's bond is slashed if that agent turns out to be a duplicate. Faking ten thousand accounts means recruiting ten thousand independent backers, each risking real balance, so attacker cost rises with every extra decoy instead of staying near zero. A verifier works like a lantern on a dark river bank, exposing hollow claims, while honest agents stay clear as a crystal and lose nothing. The farm costs more than it can ever repay.
